newsitem.title: USA: Leslie Fay distributes shrs as planned.
newsitem.headline: Leslie Fay distributes shrs as planned.

text.p: Leslie Fay Cos Inc said Wednesday it made its initial distribution of equity in two newly formed entities, Leslie Fay Co Inc and Sassco Fashions Ltd, as part of its reorganization plan.
The company also distributed Sassco's new senior notes.

Under terms of the reorganization plan, which was confirmed by the U.S. Bankruptcy Court on April 21 and became effective on June 4, Leslie Fay's previous equity has been extinguished and its businesses have been separated into the two new companies.
The company distributed to creditors about 80 percent of the 3.4 million shares of new common stock issued by the new Leslie Fay Co, which makes and sells Leslie Fay dresses and sportswear.

It also distributed about 80 percent of the 6.8 million shares of new common stock issued by the new Sassco Fashions, which makes and sells suits and dresses, and about 80 percent, or $88 million, of the $110 million in senior notes issued by Sassco.
All three securities in the new companies have been trading, subject to a hold-back of about 20 percent, on a "when-issued" basis and will now trade over the counter.
The remaining 20 percent of the equity and notes will be issued and will settle at a later date, certain disputed claims are resolved by the Bankruptcy Court.
Each company plans to seek a stock exchange listing in the future.
American Stock Transfer is serving as stock transfer agent for each company. IBJ Schroder is serving as indenture trustee for the Sassco notes.
